# Vendored from AI-Assisted Work

`bundle.schema.json` and `../validate-bundle.mjs` are copies of `schemas/bundle.schema.json` and `scripts/validate-bundle.mjs` in [AI-Assisted Work](https://github.com/dermot-obrien/ai-assisted-work), taken at commit 793aca9. `work.schema.json` is a copy of AAW's work ontology module, which lives in AAW at `skills/work/assets/work.schema.json`; this bundle's own ontology module extends it.

They are copied rather than fetched so CI needs no network and no other repository. Do not edit them here: change them in AAW, then copy them again and update the commit above.
